title: Corso manuscript: trapped being asks to lower the radar

tellings.quote: maybe something like Corso said in his manuscript where he encountered a trapped bean who said, "Hey, lower the radar so we can get out of here."

plain: A manuscript by a man named Philip J. Corso is said to describe him meeting a trapped non-human being who asked him to switch off the radar so that it and others could escape. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb (UAP stands for "unidentified anomalous phenomena", the government's newer term for UFOs) brings it up as a possibility. He quotes the being as saying, "Hey, lower the radar so we can get out of here," which, if true, would mean radar can interfere with these craft.
